slides.headlineRest: Breach May Expose AI Provider API Keys
slides.body: On the night of October 16, an intruder accessed a legacy system at OpenCode, leading to a potential security incident. This breach may have exposed third-party AI provider keys that users had saved within OpenCode Console, the company's optional hosted service. These keys are used by the Console to call providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google, allowing team members to utilize their AI models. The company has acknowledged the intrusion and the potential exposure of these critical API keys. Users should be aware of this incident.
